name: PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk
summary: As a technology company, PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk is primarily involved in the creation and distribution of shopping vouchers and various gift cards. The company provides both physical and digital voucher options, which are primarily accessed via its "Ultra Voucher" mobile application, alongside its traditional gift card offerings. Users benefit from the functionality to easily send acquired vouchers to others as presents. These vouchers are valid across an extensive array of merchant categories, including beauty and relaxation, major retail department stores, e-commerce, entertainment venues, food and beverage establishments, hotels and travel services, accessories and jewelry, diverse lifestyle services, and investment opportunities. Founded in 2017, PT Trimegah Karya Pratama Tbk is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia, and functions as a subsidiary of PT Trimegah Sumber Mas.
